lines.text: How did people write code before screens?
In 1946, programmers wrote code with cables. Each new problem took days to plug in.

design_ref_text: Every machine you use today started as an idea someone sketched on paper. Some of those ideas took years to work, and a few of them changed everything.
matthew_ref_text: So I'm building an app that turns them into an actual plan. Copy a TikTok link, open Trip and it asks, add this TikTok. It reads the caption and pulls out the place it names.
m2_ref_text: You've saved forty TikToks for this trip. And on the trip, you'll open none of them.
